summary: Nonzero cells form 8-connected groups. In each group the plurality color is the main shape (4+ cells, strict plurality, non-solid polyomino) and every other cell is a seed; canonical groups keep their 1..3 seeds in the three ring cells around ONE corner of the main shape's bbox with the corner cell occupied. Each seed paints the main shape mirrored across the bbox side(s) it indicates (a corner-ring seed can mirror both axes) in its own color; the output is the input plus these mirrored copies.
